rubrics: The response should correctly identify that the player who completes the last construction gets the exclusive opportunity to perform the Large Final Construction action for 8VP.
The response should mention the cost this final action: 1 gold, 1 wood, 1 paint, and 1 iron.
The response should not use emojis.
The response should correctly state that completing the last construction triggers the end of the game (specifically, the round finishes so all players have played the same number of turns).
